hook.text: 'She runs' is fine. 'She run' sounds off. The verb must agree with the subject.

buildup.text: Agreement means a word changes form to match features of another word in the sentence.

discovery.text: English only marks subject-verb agreement in present tense third-person singular (-s).

twist.text: Spanish verbs agree with six person-number combinations; Arabic adds gender to the mix.

climax.text: Agreement errors reveal processing limits—speakers trip on long-distance agreement.

punchline.text: Words echo each other's features across the sentence.

quiz.question: What is grammatical agreement?
options: A word changes to match features of another word
Two words share the same meaning
